blocks.html: With the endeavor to reduce the transmission of COVID-19 virus and mitigate its impact, Robinsons Land Corporation and Philippine Red Cross (PCR) enter into a partnership agreement to setup twenty (20) Saliva Drive-Thru Collection Sites for RT-PCR Testing in various Robinsons Malls branches nationwide.

The official launch of the Saliva Drive-Thru Collections Sites in Robinsons Malls was recently held in Robinsons Place Manila together with the ceremonial contract signing led by RLC executives and PRC team members: (from left) Robinsons Malls Operations Director for Luzon Irving L. Wu, RLC Senior Vice President and Business Unit General Manager for Commercial Centers Division Arlene G. Magtibay, Philippine Red Cross Chairman/CEO Hon. Richard J. Gordon, and Philippine Red Cross Secretary General Elizabeth S. Zavalla.

By taking advantage of Robinsons Malls’ strategic locations in key cities, PRC’s Drive-Thru Saliva Collection Sites will now be more accessible to the public, servicing thousands of Filipinos. These are located in the following Robinsons Malls in Luzon: Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Starmills, Robinsons Luisita, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Place Manila, Robinsons Otis, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Town Mall Malabon, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Robinsons Place Imus, and Robinsons Place Gen. Trias; In Visayas: Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Place Bacolod, and Robinsons Place Pavia; and in Mindanao: Robinsons Place Butuan, Robinsons Place Valencia and Robinsons Place Iligan. Simply secure an appointment in PCR’s website and choose to visit the nearest Robinsons Mall. Operation schedule may differ per mall.
